name: Gravity WM
description: Cards grow toward the horizontal centre, up to 70% of the screen width with more rows and columns, shrink toward the sides and become icons at the edges.
author: SUPER DESKTOP examples

commands.title: Turn Gravity WM on or off

settings.title: Width at the centre (% of the screen)
settings.description: How wide a card is at the centre of the screen. Its height grows with it, and the terminal gets the extra columns and rows.

settings.title: Width near the edges (% of the screen)
settings.description: How wide a card is drawn just before it turns into an icon.

settings.title: Icon band at each side (% of half the screen)
settings.description: A card whose centre is this close to the left or right edge becomes an icon.

settings.title: Animation smoothing (ms)
settings.description: Higher is softer and slower; 0 jumps.
